Its closed objective result schema (_OBJECTIVE_SCHEMA_CLASSES, lines 77-83) permits exactly five semantic classes: OBJECTIVE_STRUCTURAL_RESULT, OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_POSITION, OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_OPPORTUNITY, OBJECTIVE_WORLD_STATUS, OBJECTIVE_MEASUREMENT. iteration_and_recurrence_advance_constra.law: SDTF R4 §9 cycle/iteration law: NO D1' FACT AT THE SAME WORLD/STATE VERSION AND VALID-TIME SLICE MAY BE ITS OWN ANCESTOR. Lawful iterative processes must advance through time/state/source version/new external fact/new witness OR explicit competent iteration/fixed-point authority. No generic cumulative scalar or solver is created.
iteration_and_recurrence_advance_constra.consequence_for_objective_feedback: A structural feedback/recurrence premise in F2 is a premise reference, not a self-ancestoring derivation. Any iterated objective consequence must advance by time, state, source version, new external fact or new witness.
iteration_and_recurrence_advance_constra.forensic_evidence: Zero occurrences of fixed_point, fixed point, iteration, RECURRENT or self_ancestor across rawlsing_next/sdtf_r4_mechanism_rule_authority_binding.py, sdtf_r4_d1_hosting_replay.py and sdtf_r4_world_response_redrive.py. SDTF §7 also states semantic adoption authorizes zero concrete rules and zero actor facts automatically, and no rule-bank or rule-instance artifact exists in the current tree.
iteration_and_recurrence_advance_constra.scope_note: This gap constrains iterated D1' consequence derivation. It does not remove the F2 structural feedback/recurrence premise reference, which remains lawful as a premise. Whether it is a terminal prerequisite gap depends on whether a future attractor-prerequisite rule registry activates recurrence premises; recorded conditionally rather than as a proved missing form.
iteration_and_recurrence_advance_constra.prohibited_response: Do not create a cumulative scalar or solver to simulate iteration; do not disable sparse checkout; do not broaden the checkout.
